blocking_findings.finding: BLOCK_SUPPORTED validation submits a module and presentationCopies, but returns only exactSourceHash without proposed source or diagnostic ID remapping. UI requires current source-hash equality before applying diagnostics. Server produces source with authoritative trivia and fresh server IDs, while the browser holds a structural draft with draft IDs. The authoritative projection/hash and node locations are not necessarily knowable by the browser, so this guard cannot be implemented unambiguously for block drafts.
blocking_findings.bounded_resolution: Bind every block-validation response to an exact candidate request digest plus baseRevision/document/draftId/epoch, and define diagnostic IDs in original draft-ID space or return a temporary inverse mapping. Return bounded proposed source/hash when source locations are offered. Apply the projection only when the originating complete candidate identity still matches; thereafter source navigation checks the returned exact source/hash envelope. SOURCE diagnostics may retain direct exact-source-hash matching. Malformed/incomplete block drafts may return structural diagnostics without invented source positions. These are advisory previews, never committed IDs or checked authority.
finite_acceptance_conditions: Changed block candidate at same accepted revision rejects an old projection even if old and new pretty text coincide.
Fresh remapped node diagnostics locate the originating draft node, not an unrelated accepted server node.
A block copied with authoritative comments receives a source preview whose hash matches exact returned bytes.
A source edit or selection epoch change prevents delayed preview/focus application.

nonblocking_implementation_clarification.requirement: Compose comment lineage back to exact accepted base when copying an already copied draft node; fresh draft nodes without accepted-base lineage carry no inherited server comments. presentationCopies cannot name a draft source.

If browser restart loses exact pending body/key, show that recovery identity is unavailable and refresh accepted head; do not promise querying an undefined receipt endpoint or fabricate a request. If keyed receipt lookup is desired, specify its authorized bounded API before implementing it.

A candidate cannot be labeled BLOCK_SUPPORTED with a fabricated graph. Deterministically choose rejection or an explicit unavailable-location result permitted by contract; source positions may be unavailable while the correctly elaborated typed graph remains valid. Never silently classify parser-invalid text as TEXT_ONLY.
